master_dataset.rule: One canonical SQLite file holds linked law, incidents, labels, facts, conversation examples and embedded hash-checked source artifacts. Quarantined public files are provenance only until individually approved. Never pass the whole database to a training notebook because it contains sealed test cases.

scenario.rule: A scenario is an incident family. Paraphrases and translations share scenario_group and split. Silver is train only. AI-reviewed cases may enter the sealed test but must be reported as AI-labeled, not independently validated legal truth.

scenario_fact.rule: Evidence span must point to user-supplied text when a fact is recorded as present; unknown is never guessed.

scenario_provision_label.rule: Every accepted label has a rationale, named reviewer and review date. A possible label for accepted training/evaluation must be in recommendable_provision.

conversation_example.rule: Draft and edit examples carry structured tool payloads; the final local save requires explicit user confirmation.

pilot_targets.purpose: Validate labels, retrieval and workflow before expanding. Not sufficient to claim final legal performance.

final_training_targets.distinct_reviewed_scenarios: 300 is an initial research milestone, not enough by itself to claim a properly trained full-coverage model; expand according to per-section and workflow gaps
final_training_targets.training_variations: 500-1500, train split only and spot reviewed
final_training_targets.minimum_positive_coverage_per_recommenda: 5 train and 2 sealed-test distinct incidents; this is only an inspection floor, not evidence of performance
final_training_targets.minimum_workflow_action_coverage: 3 reviewed examples for each supported assistant action; expand further where edits, confirmation, or cancellations fail evaluation
final_training_targets.minimum_hindi_coverage: 20 Romanized Hindi and 20 Devanagari incidents across outcomes; expand from error analysis
final_training_targets.rule: Before a full-coverage claim, review every intended law provision and achieve substantive positive, near-miss, abstention and conversation coverage for each relevant group. Development errors determine further data collection. No fixed row count guarantees model quality; report actual counts and held-out results.

export_gate: only approved provision IDs in positive labels
accepted scenarios have outcome, privacy review, reviewer, date and review tier
accepted provision_match scenarios have reviewed possible labels
abstention scenarios have no possible label
no exact or near duplicate crosses splits
sealed test never used for model or prompt selection
dataset card and source/license ledger stored with versioned export
train/dev/test and KB hashes saved in Colab run manifest
